items.note: The Kotlin half is red at the freeze because modules/artwork is not a Gradle project yet (the T8-01 precedent).

Spec check issue 1: PreparedArtwork is a public interface with an internal implementation, and ArtworkAnswer.Bytes has a public constructor. The capture against Jellyscale on a device is item 7's gate.

Spec check issues 2 and 3, settled as recommended: a width below 1 is refused and a width above the cap is capped; ArtworkRequest.cappedWidth(type, width) in the session HTTP package is the one cap, used by ArtworkFetch and by ArtworkKey.of, which is the view's prop conversion and refuses a NaN, infinite or sub-1 width (ArtworkLoaderTest).

Spec check issues 6 and 9: judgeArtworkCapture allows a repeat only right after a 503 with Retry-After: 0, as judgeCapture does; a hit for an ended session drops that session's entries. Eviction is held in ArtworkLoaderTest; no separate ByteBoundedLruTest is frozen. The second visit on a device is item 7's gate.

The placeholder is the plain surface2 the owner accepted as a provisional stand-in (docs/specs/decisions-owner-inbox-2026-11-23b.md section 3); BlurHash is its own task. T3-08's frozen media-card.test.tsx item 6 still holds the title on a failed slot. The 1920x1080 screenshot is for review.
The scroll through the fixture Home with the canary token runs on a device under item 7's gate; pnpm lint:logs gains the modules/artwork roots in the implementation.

items.why: A pinned Jellyscale, Docker and an emulator cannot run in the red gate. Evidence: release-evidence/wire/summary.txt from CI's wire job on the pull request's head holding 'artwork-header-and-cache jellyscale T3-11 pass', a pass line for every other T3-11 and T3-05 pair and no fail line, plus the same file from the implementer's own pnpm tv:wire --task T3-11. The host judges are frozen in scripts/tv-wire-artwork.test.ts ('T3-11 item 7:') and run in pnpm check.
